texts: Level of exceedance (annual carbon / boundary, log scale)
Level of exceedance, Ability to pay (AtP)
note: 2 °C carrying capacity (Bjørn & Hauschild 2015). Log axis: the AtP LoE is 4.0 × the AR LoE in every year. Monte Carlo bands: within-variant uncertainty (population, dwelling size, completion rate, carbon factors). Carbon: construction (A1–A5 and soil) plus maintenance (B2, B4) occurring each year, buildings built from 2026; later events and C1–C4 are committed after 2050; A1–A3 of the case-study items decarbonised after Horup et al. 2025 (item-level mapping), A4–A5 e^(−0.01 (t − 2025)) after Resch et al. 2021, C1–C4 and soil at 2025.
